templates.forall: Is there a {obj} in all {N} images? Please answer with Yes or No.
templates.exists: Is there a {obj} in any of the {N} images? Please answer with Yes or No.

generator: src/data.py generate_questions (minimal pairs, per-(seed, class, N) RNG)
source: COCO 2017 (train/val splits from train2017, test splits from val2017)
coco2014: not used as an image source. COCO 2017 re-splits the 2014 images with the same image ids; 2014 file names appear only in the MIHBench exclusion below (converted to ids)

unseen_class.status: deferred (classes fixed now, questions generated later)
unseen_class.rule: COCO classes not in main 20 with val2017 present count >= min over main classes and median max-bbox-area ratio within [min, max] of main-class medians; random.Random(seed).sample(eligible, n)
